39/G.goal: Explain the organization of object interaction in immersive XR experience design, from the main interaction categories and selection criteria to the major selection and manipulation techniques.
39/G.achieves: It prepares the learner to specify object interaction in the XR system case study by understanding the available techniques and the criteria for choosing selection techniques.

39/O1.goal: Establish the framework for object interaction in immersive experience design by identifying the main interaction categories and the criteria for choosing object selection techniques.
39/O1.achieves: It gives the learner a vocabulary and decision basis for specifying object interaction requirements in the XR system case study.

39/O2.goal: Explain the major object selection techniques in immersive environments, including hand-based, pointing-based, image-plane, and volumetric selection.
39/O2.achieves: It lets the learner compare selection techniques and match one to the target objects, viewpoint, distance, and task in the XR system.

39/O3.goal: Describe the main object manipulation techniques in immersive environments, including hand-based, indirect, bimanual, and integrated hybrid manipulation.
39/O3.achieves: It lets the learner identify manipulation approaches that fit the object properties and interaction requirements of the XR system.
